rationale: Package.ps1 copies a fixed list of root documents into the shipped ZIP. CREDITS.md carries the downstream author, the original author, the licence and the 'not an official build' notice; FORK-README.md explains the fork and the Corresponding Source. Both must travel inside every distributed binary package, not just live on GitHub.
compliance: AGPL-3.0-only section 5(a) (prominent modification notices) and section 6 (conveying with the licence and notices). Added files are hashed into package-manifest.json automatically because the copy happens before New-DeviceBatteryPackageManifest.
note: {MATCH} append style: the anchor stays in the file, so the patch stays idempotent and survives upstream edits to the surrounding line.
